data.name: Gunjitha
data.long_meaning: Gunji, meaning 'sound,' represents the triumphant and victorious vibrations of the universe. Tha, signifies Goddess Tripura Sundari, the embodiment of female power and creativity. Thus, Gunjitha is the one who brings the sound of victory in the presence of the divine.
